verdict.rationale: Revenue forecasting is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows generic reporting: custom dashboards, pre-built sales reports, and 'revenue analytics reports' (hubspot-docs-49, -36, -42). It never mentions a forecasting tool, weighted pipeline value, deal-stage probabilities, or close-date-based projections. General reporting is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
